global_artifacts.name: source.tar.gz
global_artifacts.what: the source tree a distro or an auditor builds from, with its own `.sha256`

global_artifacts.name: fathom-cli-installer.sh
global_artifacts.what: the `curl … | sh` script for Linux and macOS; picks the target from the machine

global_artifacts.name: fathom-cli-installer.ps1
global_artifacts.what: the `irm … | iex` script for Windows, so a Windows user is not told to use bash

global_artifacts.name: sha256.sum
global_artifacts.what: one digest per artefact, so a download can be checked without trusting the transport

installer_env.name: FATHOM_CLI_DOWNLOAD_URL
installer_env.what: point the installer at a mirror instead of a public release (used in this repository's own end-to-end installer test)

installer_env.name: FATHOM_CLI_INSTALLER_GHE_BASE_URL
installer_env.what: GitHub Enterprise base URL, second spelling

installer_env.name: FATHOM_CLI_GITHUB_TOKEN
installer_env.what: a token for a private release, so an alpha can be gated without an object store

installer_env.name: FATHOM_CLI_NO_MODIFY_PATH
installer_env.what: leave `PATH` (and the shell rc files) alone

installer_env.name: FATHOM_CLI_PRINT_VERBOSE
installer_env.what: more output when the install is going wrong
